description: Network-related constants for the g8e Operator: default endpoints, gateway hostnames, and transient error patterns.

DefaultEndpoint.description: Default g8e Operator endpoint hostname; also the TLS ServerName for raw IP connections

GatewayInternalHostname.description: Internal hostname for Gateway TLS connections; certificate is issued to this name

GatewayHTTPPort.description: Gateway HTTP port (plaintext, for health checks and redirects)

GatewayHTTPSPort.description: Gateway HTTPS port (mTLS, for all operator traffic)

GatewayHTTPBase.description: Base URL for gateway HTTP endpoint

GatewayHTTPSBase.description: Base URL for gateway HTTPS endpoint

TransientNetworkErrorPatterns.description: Substring patterns identifying transient network errors suitable for retry logic
